name: swipe-toast
title: Swipe Toast
description: A compact dark toast for the corner of the screen. It holds a title, a short line, an Undo button and a glowing orange line that shrinks as its timer runs out; it can be swiped down or closed with Escape.
use: A file or form action succeeds and the page needs a small confirmation with a short window to undo.
avoid: Its timer can run out before someone reads it, and the fixed-corner version covers page content on small screens.
a11y: The card is a polite live region and Escape closes it, but there is no visible focus ring and swiping has no keyboard equivalent. (keyboard: partial, labels: partial, reduced motion: respected)
looks: A charcoal rounded card holding a bold title, a muted description and a small light Undo pill, with a thin orange hairline along its bottom edge. It floats over a black stage above a light Archive file button.
behaves: The toast rises into view, then its orange fuse shrinks steadily from one end while hover or focus pauses it. Swiping it down throws it off-screen, and Escape or the Undo button dismisses it early.
customise: Title, description, icon, action label, colours, width, radius, fuse position, duration and hover pause are props; the dismiss logic stays in the source.
weight: light: One card, a spring on drag and a single browser animation for the fuse.
demo: Repeated "Q3-report.pdf archived" toast with a "Moved to Archive" line, Undo and an Archive file button.
polishWhy: Crisp card and a clear fuse metaphor; the description and fuse are both low contrast on charcoal.
